notes.title: LIGHTHOUSE OF GUIDING FLAMES' UPDATE FOR WINDOWS!
notes.content:
The first of two planned patches is out! The novel deserves some cosmetic changes, and now we're ready to publish some of them.

[b]Updates:[/b]

- new design of the dialogue window and bigger font size for comfortable reading (if you see light textbox after the update, switch it to dark in the game settings)
- new art and main menu design
- new functions in settings: skip all text, turn off all sounds, mousewheel action
- fixed the Scenes crash bug
- fixed typos, added slight corrections of text
- achievements secion

[b]Technical details:[/b]

- the game perceives text as completely new; to skip it, turn on "skip all text" option in settings
- the novel now works only on 64-bit version of Windows
- Linus and Mac versions aren't updated, because we can't test them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35439845/caa2c10ed69f6afd12d55e1ea86cca1beca22c5b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Autumn time!
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.5.[/b]

Autumn is in the yard, probably someone wants to sit under a blanket with a cup of cocoa.
On the eve of Halloween, and especially for story lovers, we have prepared an update:

[list]
[*] Added soundtrack
[*] Improved readability of the text. Now, in the settings menu, the “Readability Mode” switcher has appeared, which changes the standard design of the text and textbox to the dark one.
[*] Added a free set of promotional art published during preparation for the release.
[/list]

P.s. To find artwork open game directory via Steam settings(or find yourself) - there would be a folder called "ART".
